entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi, thank you for calling VeloFit! My name is Steve. How can I help you today?
Hello, Steve. I'd like to start a return for a VeloBand Pulse I bought last month.

Okay, I can definitely help with that. Let me just pull up your account. One moment... Okay, I see your order here. You're a VIP member, thank you for your loyalty! And you're looking to return the VeloBand Pulse.
Alright, I see you received it about 25 days ago. That's well within our 90 days return window, so that is absolutely no problem at all.
Oh, great. So you can process that for me?

Yes, of course. I've just initiated the return. I'm emailing you a prepaid return label right now. You should see it in your inbox in the next few minutes. Just print that out, attach it to the box, and drop it off.
Perfect, that was easy. Thank you.
You're very welcome. And as a thank you for being a VIP member, I've also added a 20% discount coupon to your account for your next purchase. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Wow, thank you! No, that's everything. I appreciate your help, Steve.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day!
